item.title: Deadline to change party affiliation for June primary is Saturday
item.description: Press release:If you would like to change your Party affiliation to be eligible to vote in the Primary, held on June 23, you must complete a voter registration application now. Forms must be postmarked no later than Feb. 14. Please either visit our website for more information, https://www.geneseeny.gov/Department-Content/Board-of-Elections

item.title: Italian-American legislators offering college scholarships
item.description: Press release:New York State Senator George Borrello announced that the New York Conference of Italian American State Legislators is accepting applications for four $3,000 scholarships, two academic and two athletic.Scholarships are available to residents of the 57th Senate District who are current college students or high school seniors

item.title: Law and Order: Two Batavia residents charged in multi-county organized retail theft scheme
item.description: Kirk Thomas Kirk A. Thomas Jr., 41, of Batavia, is charged with two counts of conspiracy 5th, two counts of grand larceny 4th, and enterprise corruption. Thomas was arrested on Jan. 12 following a multi-agency investigation into an organized retail theft scheme targeting Walmart locations across Orleans, Genesee, and Monroe counties.
